title: Notification stack
description: Notifications or DMs dropping in one after another and stacking with depth: each new card lands on top and pushes the older ones down, smaller, dimmer and softer; after a beat the last one lands in the accent colour. Over video by default. For 'my phone won't stop' moments, social proof, app promos and reaction hooks.

default: Mara Lindqvist: Rough cut is up, notes by six?
Theo Brandt: Client approved the opener
Ines Okoro: Can we get the vertical by Friday?
items.description: One per card, oldest first, as 'Sender: message' (the text before the first colon is the bold title).

style.description: notification (app tile, app name, title and body) or dm (round avatar with initials, name and message).

highlight_last.description: The last card lands in the accent colour after a short pause (the punchline).

position.description: Where the stack sits: auto (top on vertical frames, top-right on landscape), top, center or right.
